assign.request: Overhaul the page generator's word semantics per the owner's 2026-08-27 critique: words need children to visualize and all children look identical (seeded-DISTINCT placeholder content, honest empty state); tabs and vtabs must switch IN PLACE, not spawn a column; rail dies as a word, list becomes the inbox (small previews left, detail opens right); wall and grid merge; prune words that do not earn codification and show them as simple new Page() patterns.
steps: Read the spec, the generator, ext/tabs, core columns
Decide the word list: prune, merge, reshape
gen.js + rules.js: v2 vocabulary and weights
tree.js: in-place tabs/vtabs, inbox list, seeded-distinct content
generator.css: pictures for the new words, the panel, previews
rolls.js sketch + page.js note + readme patterns
Palette sync: core/Page BANDS, ext/demo mini

log.msg: MODEL v2: nine block words -> five, and every one is a behaviour. Kept wall list prose (child opens a NEW column) and tabs vtabs (child swaps IN PLACE). Cut grid (a wall with a smaller cell), flush (a wall with no gap), crumbs (a strip core already derives) and rail (the owner: a slightly different vtabs) - each is four lines of new Page() in the readme.

IN-PLACE PROOF, column bodies before -> after clicking a tab: 1280 2->2->2, 1920 2->2->2, 3440 2->2->2 (tabs); vtabs 2->2 at all three. The list inbox opens the detail rightward: 2->3 at every width. A tab's OWN child escapes the panel and opens a column: /tabs/list/ 2 bodies, click a preview inside it 3, url /tabs/list/prose/. Zero console errors at every width.

Switch-in-place is two lines of an overridden container(): an in-place parent hands me its $panel; my own children walk PAST any page that is itself in a panel to the nearest one that still owns a slot in the row. The second line is the one that is easy to miss - without it a grandchild renders stacked inside the panel.

Seeded-distinct children: every config carries a key derived from its PLACE in the spec (parent, index, word, arity), and fill.js draws the page's name, its groups, line counts and widths from it - so a typed spec gets distinct children with no seed at all. Measured v1 vs v2 in node on seeds 0/1/7/42/1234/999999: 6 of 6 moved, all six the same line count (the draw sequence is untouched, only which word each pick lands on).

Palette synced: Building blocks = columns tabs vtabs list wall prose (6), the four cut words moved down to Recipes (10) where a composed shape belongs; 29 cards still, counted headless. ext/demo mini gained one picture - list is an inbox now, not a plain stack.

TRAP, cost an hour: a headless probe that writes its screenshots into public/ reloads the page it is probing. The dev server watches the tree, so every shot() fired LiveReload and the next click landed mid-reload - column counts came back [] at 1920 and 3440, intermittently, with ZERO console errors. It reads exactly like a routing bug. Shots go in the scratchpad and are copied in at the end.

Also applied the sibling core agent's three lines to core/Page/page.js (my fence): methods: +nearest topic document, notes: +roles panels, files: +overview/columns/refs+panels. All the doc/method and overview dirs exist; Page loads clean at 1600.

assign.outcome:
**Five block words, and every one is a behaviour.** Nine became five: `wall` `list` `prose` open a NEW column to the right; `tabs` `vtabs` swap IN PLACE and the row never grows. `grid` `flush` `crumbs` `rail` were cut - each changed how the links *looked*, never where a child went - and ship as four-line `new Page()` patterns instead.

![a tab switching in place](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/tabs-after-1280.png)

**The proof.** Column bodies before -> after clicking a tab: **2 -> 2 -> 2** at 1280, 1920 and 3440, for `tabs` and `vtabs` alike. The `list` inbox opens its detail rightward: **2 -> 3**. A tab's own child escapes the panel into the row - `/tabs/list/` is 2 bodies, clicking a preview inside it is 3, at `/tabs/list/prose/`. Zero console errors at every width.

- [Generator](/framework/core/Page/generator/) - the five words live, `model v2` printed beside the seed
- [The four cut words, as patterns](/framework/core/Page/generator/readme/) - `previews().style("--column", "8em")` and three more
- [The record](/framework/core/Page/generator/doc/decisions.md) - why in-place is two lines of `container()`, and three measured traps
- [Permutation wall](/framework/core/Page/generator/rolls/) - 24 tiles, 24 distinct pictures, 4 rule rows
- [Palette](/framework/core/Page/) - Building blocks 6, Recipes 10, still 29 cards
- Shots: [inbox](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/list-inbox-1920.png) - [side tabs](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/vtabs-after-1920.png) - [wall](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/wall-1280.png) - [deep](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/tabs-deep-1600.png) - [empty state](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/empty-state-1600.png) - [palette](/framework/ai/2026-08-27/gen-semantics/palette-1600.png)

**Siblings are distinct now.** Every page carries a key derived from its place in the spec; `fill.js` draws its name, its groups, its line counts and widths from it - so a *typed* spec gets distinct children with no seed at all, and the same spec twice is the same page twice down to the last bar. A nav word with no children shows its empty state.

**A seed is an address against one MODEL.** v1 -> v2 moved **6 of 6** proof seeds, all six keeping their exact line count - the draw sequence is untouched, only which word each pick lands on. Deep v1 urls 404; nothing repairs them, and nothing should.

**Left:** `wall` and `list` still differ only in how they present the pick - a stricter reading of the rule merges them and makes previews a token. The owner asked for the inbox by name, so it is a word; the argument is named in decisions.md.
